title: Proforma Invoice Template
description: Free proforma invoice format for India with PI number, validity, buyer GSTIN, HSN codes, CGST/SGST, advance terms and bank details. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Itemised table with HSN, quantity, rate and GST split
Validity, advance payment and delivery terms
Clear 'not a tax invoice' declaration and bank details
useCases: Buyer budget approvals and purchase orders
research: All references show PI number, date and validity, seller and buyer GSTIN, place of supply, items with HSN, quantity, rate and estimated GST, payment and delivery terms, bank details, and a clear note that a proforma is not a tax invoice and creates no GST liability.

rows: [Control panel with VFD and level sensors]

blocks.text: Amount in words: **[Rupees Five Lakh Twenty-Three Thousand Nine Hundred Twenty Only]**

blocks.heading: Terms
text: 1. **Advance:** 50% ([₹2,61,960.00]) to confirm the order; balance before dispatch.
2. **Delivery:** within [4 weeks] of receiving the advance, ex-works Chakan. Freight and transit insurance extra at actuals.
3. **Validity:** prices hold until the date above. GST will be charged at the rate in force on the date of the tax invoice.
4. **Warranty:** [12 months] from dispatch against manufacturing defects.

blocks.heading: Declaration
blocks.text: This is a proforma invoice issued for quotation and advance payment only. It is **not a tax invoice**, creates no GST liability and cannot be used to claim input tax credit. A GST tax invoice will be issued at the time of supply.
